name: Secure Semiconductor Manufacturing, LLC Office
old_description: At Secure Semiconductor Manufacturing LLC, we specialize in fast-turn, high-reliability PCB assembly and electronic manufacturing services for innovators, engineers, and hardware startups. Whether you’re building the next big thing in defense, aerospace, medical, or advanced commercial tech, we provide precision manufacturing with the security and confidentiality your IP demands.
about:
Secure Semiconductor Manufacturing, LLC (SSM) operates from Lebo, Kansas, as a 100% American-owned and operated advanced electronics manufacturer. The company was founded with a mission to restore critical electronics manufacturing capabilities to the United States by providing secure, reliable, and high-quality PCB fabrication and assembly services for commercial, industrial, aerospace, defense, medical, energy, telecommunications, and critical infrastructure markets.

SSM provides printed circuit board (PCB) fabrication, printed circuit board assembly (PCBA), surface mount technology (SMT) assembly, through-hole assembly, and mixed-technology assembly including RF. The facility supports prototype through low-to-medium volume production with quick-turn manufacturing, design for manufacturability (DFM) support, automated optical inspection (AOI), quality inspection and testing, conformal coating, potting, high-density interconnect (HDI) and controlled impedance capabilities, counterfeit component prevention, and traceability. Workmanship meets IPC-A-610 Class 3 standards.

The company serves aerospace and avionics, defense and government contracting, medical devices and health technology, energy and industrial automation, telecommunications and wireless infrastructure, as well as commercial and industrial innovators. SSM also supports startups and commercial product developers with scalable, cost-effective PCB solutions, full engineering support, BOM optimization, component sourcing, and rapid domestic prototyping.

SSM differentiates itself through 100% U.S.-based manufacturing, ITAR registration, AS9100 and ISO 9001 certified processes, full confidentiality and traceability, and responsive engineering support. Its stated mission extends beyond manufacturing to eliminating reliance on offshore electronics production, enhancing national security and supply chain resiliency, fostering domestic economic growth, and delivering environmentally responsible manufacturing.
